authorization: Explicit targeted user instruction on 2026-09-14 to deeply research and incorporate the six new rules into MODEL_1.
purpose: Convert market-heat, competitive incentives, schedule priority, financial incentives and club-relationship narratives into falsifiable, auditable pre-match evidence rather than post-hoc storytelling.

price_popularity_distortion.principle: Ask whether the market is pricing into, resisting or diverging from observable/narrative popularity. Do not label a bookmaker as intentionally creating heat or cold without direct evidence of intent.
required_inputs: Titan de-vigged 1X2 opening and same-time comparison
Titan AH line and water lifecycle
opening rationality and adjacent counterfactual prices
team/form/name/scoreline narratives that can create attraction

market_separation.one_x_two: Evaluate favorite-longshot, sentiment and hot-hand style distortions separately.
market_separation.asian_handicap: Do not import 1X2 favorite-longshot conclusions mechanically into AH.
market_separation.totals: Treat public Over attraction separately from side-market attraction.

public_betting_data.forbidden: Do not manufacture a public betting percentage from odds movement or media narrative.

price_popularity_distortion.formal_use: May alter interpretation of market attraction and favorite-failure/upset paths when supported by same-time, cross-market evidence. No fixed coefficient.

bookmaker_pattern_audit.principle: Treat bookmaker behavior as repeated observable quote geometry, not anthropomorphic intent.
required_checks: whether divergence is led or followed by peers
whether the same signal exists in 1X2, AH and OU
whether a proposed pattern survives adjacent-price counterfactuals
forbidden_shortcuts: one low favorite price equals bookmaker confidence
one line drop equals rejection of that side
one company divergence equals inside information
historical pattern may be cited without matched league/line/time-slice controls

competitive_incentive_state.principle: Replace vague motivation labels with the marginal sporting and financial value of the current match under W/D/L counterfactuals.
competition_specific_targets: league-phase seeding/byes/home-leg advantages when competition rules make them material
competitive_incentive_state.midtable_rule: Do not label a midtable team unmotivated merely from rank. A dead-rubber/low-marginal-value state requires all meaningful sporting endpoints to be near-saturated or unreachable, followed by checks for derby, coach/contract, bonus and other verified incentives.
competitive_incentive_state.dominant_leader_rule: For breakaway leaders such as Bayern/PSG-type cases, model domestic objective saturation and resource allocation separately. A nearly secured title can raise rotation propensity before a high-priority European match, but it does not imply deliberate point dropping or automatic non-cover.
competitive_incentive_state.formal_use: May affect rotation/resource-allocation hypotheses and interpretation of economic-win versus cover paths. No fixed points or grade shift.

schedule_priority_resource_allocation.principle: Fixture density changes recovery, injury exposure, selection and resource allocation; it does not have one universal result sign.
schedule_priority_resource_allocation.post_europe_anti_double_counting: If post_europe_residual_flag applies, do not add a second generic fatigue or venue-quadrant penalty for the same exposure.

rotation_model.rotation_propensity: Can rise when next-match importance exceeds current-match importance and schedule stress is high.
rotation_model.rotation_cost: Falls when squad depth/replacement quality is strong; deep squads can rotate without the same performance loss.

schedule_priority_resource_allocation.formal_use: Current validated post-Europe residual keeps its own authority. New pre-Europe/venue-quadrant interactions remain qualitative/shadow until historical and forward validation.

financial_marginal_match_value.principle: Use verified marginal cash stakes, not headline prize pools. Money matters through the change in expected club value caused by W/D/L and through the club's financial constraints.
financial_marginal_match_value.source_rule: Use current season official league/competition regulations or circulars where available; do not hard-code stale prize amounts across seasons.
financial_marginal_match_value.scaling: Where comparison is needed, consider the cash delta relative to club revenue/wage bill/liquidity, but do not use an arbitrary universal multiplier before calibration.
forbidden_shortcuts: large nominal prize equals maximum effort
small nominal prize equals no motivation
unverified bonus rumor receives formal weight
financial_marginal_match_value.formal_use: Supports competitive-incentive and rotation analysis; no direct probability shift until calibrated.

relationship_integrity_risk.principle: Map relationships and conflicts of interest, but keep a strict firewall between evidence of a relationship and evidence of match coordination/reciprocity.

A_VERIFIED_CONTROL_OR_REGULATORY: official common ownership/control or multi-club group
shared directors or decisive influence documented by official filings/regulator
official disciplinary, court or integrity finding
C_REPUTABLE_REPORTING: specific reputable media reporting with named mechanism or evidence

relationship_integrity_risk.coordination_claim_rule: A relationship, common ownership, transfer history or asymmetric table need does not prove a planned result. Explicit coordination language is forbidden without direct case-specific evidence.
relationship_integrity_risk.market_cross_check: If a relationship hypothesis exists, test whether Titan pricing shows an otherwise-unexplained residual anomaly after strength, incentive, lineup and schedule controls. Market confirmation still does not prove coordination.
relationship_integrity_risk.formal_use: Verified relationships can raise integrity/context review and Red Team attention. Reciprocity remains hypothesis-only unless case-specific evidence is unusually strong; no automatic bet direction or grade.

anti_double_counting.market_heat_vs_market_attraction: One evidence item may support only one primary narrative/market demand channel.
anti_double_counting.motivation_vs_finance: Financial stakes are a component of marginal match value, not a second independent bonus.
anti_double_counting.schedule_vs_post_europe: Validated post-Europe residual and generic schedule fatigue cannot both penalize the same exposure.
anti_double_counting.schedule_vs_lineup: Expected rotation is a schedule mechanism; actual confirmed lineup impact belongs to Stage 6 and supersedes speculative rotation.
anti_double_counting.relationship_vs_motivation: Asymmetric table need and club relationship are separate facts; do not multiply them into a coordination conclusion.

red_team_requirements: For every claimed heat/cold state, construct a non-intent market-making explanation.
For every motivation claim, test whether the target was already priced into Titan odds.
For every schedule claim, test deep-squad and opponent-quality counterexamples.
For every finance claim, test whether sporting utility or prestige dominates cash utility.
For every relationship claim, state the strongest non-coordination explanation and evidence tier.
research_promotion_rule: Any future fixed coefficient, threshold or automatic grade/probability/handicap adjustment requires time-safe historical validation plus forward validation and a new explicit user authorization.
